version.promotionalText: Count skewers from a photo, check each marker, and keep the result with a note. On-device processing, local history, and sharing when you choose.
version.description:
Count Stick helps you count skewers from a photo and check the result before using it. Take a picture or choose one from your library, review the markers, and correct any missed or extra items.

A focused counting workflow
• Count from camera photos or selected images.
• Review the markers on your photo and the total together.
• Add or remove markers manually, with undo for corrections.
• Save a checked result with a note in local history.
• Reopen or delete saved records, and share a marked result image when needed.

Processing stays on your device
The counting model runs on your device. Photos are not uploaded to a server for counting. No account is required.

One purchase
The download purchase includes the app’s features. There are no in-app subscriptions or ads.

For a clearer result, keep the skewers visible, use even lighting, and avoid overlapping items where possible. Automatic recognition can miss or double-count items. Check and correct the markers before relying on a total, especially for billing or stock records.

Support: https://www.xmaillc.com/count-stick-support.html
Privacy policy: https://www.xmaillc.com/count-stick-privacy.html

version.description:
Count Stick 帮你从照片中清点签子，并在使用结果前逐个核对。拍照或选择相册图片，查看数量与标记，再修正漏标或误标。

从拍照到留存
• 拍摄照片，或选择已有图片进行计数。
• 在照片上查看标记，同时核对总数。
• 手动添加、删除标记，操作失误可撤销。
• 确认结果后添加备注，保存到本地历史记录。
• 重新查看或删除记录，按需分享带标记的结果图。

在设备上处理
计数模型在你的设备上运行，照片不会上传到服务器进行计数。无需注册账号。

一次购买
下载购买包含应用内的功能，无应用内订阅，无广告。

拍摄时请尽量让签子清晰可见，保持光线均匀，减少遮挡和重叠。自动识别可能漏计或重复计数。用于结账或库存记录前，请核对并修正标记。

支持与反馈：https://www.xmaillc.com/count-stick-support.html
隐私政策：https://www.xmaillc.com/count-stick-privacy.html

reviewNotesDraft:
No account sign-in is required. Take a camera photo or choose an image from Photos, then wait for on-device counting to finish. Review the visible markers and total. Add missing markers or remove extra ones; Undo reverses an edit. Save a checked result with a note, open it from local history, and use Share to export the marked result. Saved records can be deleted.

This is a paid-upfront app with no in-app purchases, subscriptions, advertising, or remote photo-processing service. Camera permission is requested only for taking a photo. Photo processing runs locally on the device.

Automatic counts are estimates; the interface supports manual verification and correction.
